messages:
maria-williams: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off evals for BillFold and ReconIQ for invoicing + usage reconciliation. Primary asks: accuracy of line-item matching, support for per-embedding cost attribution, and sample pricing for 10M tokens/month. Need vendor pricing + pilot credits by EOD Fri.

procurement-bot: New procurement request created: PR-2026-44. Assigned to @eli-choi. Please attach sample invoices and expected monthly volume.

eli-choi: @maria-williams adding questions:
- Does their pricing separate parsing vs reconciliation vs analytics?
- Any per-invoice or per-API-call minimums?
- Overages/annual escalator?

samira: Also ask about data retention & redaction features (we have PII in invoices). Need KMS/HSM compatibility info too.

josh_payne: Favored metric: cost per reconciled invoice + TTTR (time to true reconciliation). Ask for SLA credits on missed SLAs.

maria-williams: Agreed. Also push for a non-prod pilot environment and ability to run in our VPC (private deployment). Can they support S3 webhook ingest and line-level memoization?

eli-choi: Vendor responses summary (from calls):
BillFold: parsing API ($0.003 per page), reconciliation engine add-on ($0.02 per matched-invoice), pilot credit 5k invoices, VPC available as enterprise add-on.
ReconIQ: flat usage tiering (0-1M pages $300/mo, 1M-10M $0.00025/page), custom dedupe + audit trail included, limited pilot (2k invoices), VPC only for Dedicated customers.

procurement-bot: Uploaded vendor proposals to /shared/procurement/vendor-evals/BillFold-ReconIQ-2026.pdf :link: 

samira: ReconIQ's dedupe sounds promising but pilot cap is small. Also concerned ReconIQ's egress charges for storing structured exports — ask for sample invoice that includes egress line.

josh_payne: Can we get a TCO calc? Rough numbers: 5M pages/month, 500k reconciled invoices. Compare cost + expected ops savings.

eli-choi: Quick TCO sketch:
```
BillFold: parsing = 5M * $0.003 = $15k
reconciliation = 500k * $0.02 = $10k
Total = $25k/mo
ReconIQ: assume avg $0.00025/page for 5M = $1,250
+ storage/egress ~ $2k
+ integration/support ~ $5k
Total ~ $8.25k/mo
```
Numbers rough — need vendor firm quotes.

maria-williams: Action items:
- @eli-choi: ask ReconIQ for expanded pilot and egress detail (due Tue)
- @samira: legal & security to review VPC/enterprise notes (due Wed)
- @josh_payne: build TCO worksheet with assumptions and ops savings (due Thu)

eli-choi: I'll schedule 30m follow-up with ReconIQ for Mon. Ping me if any other Qs.

maria-williams: Thanks all. If ReconIQ can expand pilot and confirm egress policy, leaning towards them for cost, else BillFold for feature parity.

legal: noted. Please attach vendor DPA + SOC2 attestation before pilot starts. :memo:

samira: Also request SOC2 + pen-test window and encryption-at-rest keys rotation docs.

eli-choi: added to the ask list. Closing loop here for now.
